title: 特朗普：伊朗协议包含我想要的99.9%
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Here's what it says, Iran will never have a nuclear weapon, that's what it says, it won't have one to buy, to develop, they will not have a nuclear weapon.
segments.zh: 协议规定伊朗永远不会拥有核武器，不能购买、不能研发，就是没有核武器。

segments.en: And I would say that's about 99.9% of what I wanted, because we couldn't let that happen, and you couldn't let that happen.
segments.zh: 这大概达到了我想要的99.9%，因为我们不能允许这种情况发生，你们也不能。

segments.en: And they won't have a nuclear weapon. Now in addition to that, the straighter is going to be open toll-free.
segments.zh: 他们不会有核武器。此外，海峡将免费开放通行。
